title: Auto Host & TTS

stageOwns: dumb local Web Speech output adapter and completion/error acknowledgement

hardGate.precondition: Sync latest origin/main, read the full Task 10 spec and current R3 lock before coding.
hardGate.stopAfter: Open/update Task 10 PR with green CI, then stop for ChatGPT review.

hardRules: Do not post comments/messages back to TikTok.
Do not add cloud TTS credentials or secrets in renderer/config.
Do not use eval, Function constructor or arbitrary executable rule expressions.
Do not speak raw arbitrary user comments in the default preset.
Do not mutate gift score, queue priority, ranking or VIP state from Auto Host actions.
Use semantic reaction/bubble slots resolved by the existing R3 theme/asset system.
Core Auto Host logic must remain free of Electron/Node/React/Pixi/Web Speech dependencies.
TTS queue must be bounded, deterministic and owned outside renderers.
requiredAcceptance: simulated follow produces deterministic announcement + TTS intent
high-value gift is thanked without double-scoring or duplicate gift FX
duplicate gift replay does not create duplicate Auto Host thanks
party goal completion and rank promotion fire once per real transition
accepted GO/JOIN command can show an R3 semantic bubble
100+ social-event burst leaves a bounded TTS queue
CONTROL reload does not reset TTS queue/runtime state
STAGE reload does not reset canonical Core state and does not replay speech unbounded
Web Speech unavailable degrades safely while visuals continue
